name: claim_gate_manager_hide
xsql:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_valid,
       'No direct reports in the position hierarchy for this period'
           AS scope_label
FROM   xactly.xc_pos_hierarchy ph
WHERE  ph.from_pos_id  = :v_master_position_id
  AND  ph.to_pos_id   <> :v_master_position_id
  AND  ph.is_active    = 1
